coaching.headline: Two lost fights gave up both Outer Towers; towers finished 0-2 in a 19-minute loss.
coaching.team: Three of the four laned matchups read theirs late; only our offlane stayed ours early and even late. A solo death at 9.2 handed their first Fangtooth. A fight at 14.9, lost 1-3, gave up our first Outer Tower; a second lost fight at 18.7 gave up the other. Towers finished 0-2.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: A 1-3 loss at 14.9 near our half cost the first Outer Tower at 15.9. A second lost fight at 18.7, the game's highest-significance fight, sat right at our second Outer Tower falling.
coaching.whatWorked: Greystone's offlane read ours early and even late, the only matchup that never went their way.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Narbash. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 1 item of it.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
ourKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
ourKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
ourKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
ourKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

enemyKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
enemyKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
enemyKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight in his zones — flank; kill the turret, dive him

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

enemyKits.combo: Thunk stun → March! speed → Song heal aura → Crash Bang Boom! AoE slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Thunk and group-buff the team through fights
enemyKits.playWith: a dive team that rides his speed and heal
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge/cleanse Thunk; he's low-damage — kill his carry through the aura

enemyKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
enemyKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
enemyKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
enemyKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
enemyKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

loadout.name: Weald
loadout.text: Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 30% Bonus Attack Speed) projectiles that each deal 7 (+1 per level) True Damage. Missiles travel through walls and disappear after 3000u. 10s cooldown per Hero. On-hit effects apply at 20% effectiveness.

loadout.text: Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 30% Bonus Attack Speed) projectiles that each deal 7 (+1 per level) True Damage. Missiles travel through walls and disappear after 3000u. 10s cooldown per Hero. On-hit effects apply at 20% effectiveness.
loadout.plain: Hitting a hero below 30% health fires missiles that pass through walls, with more missiles from bonus attack speed, which she builds a lot of. Helps finish low enemies running away.

loadout.name: Forage
loadout.text: Gain 3 additional Gold and 3 additional XP per Minion or Monster kill.
loadout.plain: Extra gold and experience from every minion and monster kill. Generic farming boost, nothing special with her kit.

loadout.name: Wind-Rider
loadout.text: Gain 15% (+1% per Level) Bonus Attack Speed for 4s after using a Dash, Leap, Teleport, or upon leaving Stealth.
loadout.plain: Leaving stealth after Heightened Senses gives extra attack speed on top of what the ability already grants, so that damage window hits even faster.

loadout.name: Pacifier
loadout.text: Adrenalize:  Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health. Killing a Hero within 3s allows Adrenalize to be recast for 6s.
loadout.plain: Dash and empower her next hit, which hits much harder on low-health targets and can be recast after a kill. Use it to finish someone softened by Piercing Shot.

amps.name: Storm Breaker
amps.how: While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Release a bolt of lightning that chains to 7 Targets.

amps.name: Sky Splitter
amps.how: On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.

ability.name: Crash Bang Boom!
ability.what: Narbash Slows himself by 30% and Channels a drum solo for 3s.

loadout.plain: Every hit of Crash Bang Boom! lowers enemy armors briefly. Your team deals more damage to everyone caught in the drum solo.

loadout.name: Exarch
loadout.text: Healing or Shielding a target (including yourself) grants them 10% Total Attack Speed and empowers their Basic Attacks to deal 10% bonus Magical Damage On-Hit for 4s.
loadout.plain: Healing or shielding a target gives them 10% attack speed and extra magic damage on basic attacks for 4s. Song health regeneration may not count as healing, so pair it with Tranquility or Sanctification.

loadout.name: Preservation
loadout.text: Healing or shielding you receive is increased by 10%.
loadout.plain: Healing and shields you receive are stronger. A defensive pick for a frontline support.

loadout.name: Delayed Fate
loadout.text: 20% of Ability damage taken is dealt to you as a 3s DoT instead.
loadout.plain: Part of ability damage you take arrives slowly instead of all at once. Helps Narbash survive burst while channeling Crash Bang Boom!.

loadout.name: Sanctification
loadout.text: Safeguard:  Grants yourself and nearby Heroes a 150 (+8%) Shield for 3s. While the Shield holds, Heroes gain 50% Tenacity. Visionary:  Gain Solstone. Increase Ward Cap from 2 to 3. Pacifist:  Receive diminishing Gold from Minion kills.
loadout.plain: Shields nearby allies and makes them resist crowd control while it holds. Pop it before the enemy engages or as your team goes in.
